title: Encoding row of a configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string of length $n$, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. The encoding row of $c$ records the bounded configuration code of $c$ at parameter $s$, together with the input bits of $x$ (using false for any out-of-range lookup), and the output summary determined by the output string of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
